Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

zuspecial 0.0.0.9000

  • Gamma and beta functions: sc_gamma(), sc_gammaln(), sc_loggamma(), sc_rgamma(), sc_gammasgn(), sc_psi(), sc_beta(), sc_betaln(), sc_binom() and sc_poch(), with complex arguments where SciPy has them.

  • Error functions: sc_erf(), sc_erfc(), sc_erfcx(), sc_erfi(), sc_erfcinv(), sc_dawsn(), the Faddeeva function sc_wofz() and sc_voigt_profile().

  • Exponential integrals: sc_exp1(), sc_expi() and sc_expn().

  • Incomplete gamma and beta functions and their inverses: sc_gammainc(), sc_gammaincc(), sc_gammaincinv(), sc_gammainccinv(), sc_betainc(), sc_betaincc(), sc_betaincinv() and sc_betainccinv(). The incomplete beta functions use Boost.Math, from the BH package, as SciPy does.

  • Normal distribution functions: sc_ndtr(), sc_log_ndtr(), sc_ndtri(), sc_ndtri_exp(), sc_owens_t(), and sc_erfinv().

  • sc_geterr(), sc_seterr() and sc_errstate() choose whether each kind of floating-point condition is ignored, warns or raises, after scipy.special.

  • zuspecial_info() reports the vendored xsf commit, the SciPy release it matches, the compiler and the function table.

Developed by Pedro Baltazar.
